Celebrations

Soft banana oat cake

Puha torta

12 months+ Replaced 40 min 8 portions

From 12 months, as an occasional soft cake. Every piece of fruit on top should squash easily between your fingers.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 2 very ripe bananas (mashed; no sugar)
  • 150 g rolled oats (binds the cake; listed as gluten)
  • 1 tbsp rapeseed or olive oil (keeps the crumb soft)
  • 50 g soft fruit (decoration only; nothing hard or sweet-shop)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 170 C.
  2. Mash the bananas with the oil.
  3. Stir in the oats to make a soft batter.
  4. Spread it in a small tin and bake until set but still soft in the middle.
  5. Cool, then shape or cut it however you like.
  6. Decorate with soft fruit only, with no sweets and no hard pieces.

Replaced

The usual turtle cake is biscuits and chocolate sweets.

Bake a soft banana and oat cake, shaped however you like, and decorate it with fruit, not sweets. Add no hard decorations.
